story.text: Under a tree the March {HARE} and the Hatter are having {TEA}, with a {DORMOUSE} fast asleep between them. “No room! No room!” they cry, though there is plenty. “Why is a {RAVEN} like a writing-{DESK}?” asks the Hatter, who has no idea himself. He has put the best {BUTTER} in his {WATCH}, and now it is always six o’clock: always tea-time.
story.caption: A Mad Tea-Party
story.credit: John Tenniel, coloured for The Nursery “Alice”, 1890
